acceptanceCriteria: `GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 GOTOOLCHAIN=local go vet ./internal/tasks/dispatch/` exits 0 on main.
`make cross-vet` exits 0 on main, and the dispatch tests still run and pass on darwin and linux.
body: Found by the 1.0.0-rc.2 release gate on candidate 0ae3f88d (hosted Release gates run 37358656556, full-gate ubuntu-24.04, cross-vet step): `vet: internal/tasks/dispatch/claim_member_test.go:13:8: undefined: testConfig`. testConfig is defined in dispatch_test.go, which carries a unix build tag; claim_member_test.go, next_stage_test.go and operator_note_test.go are untagged. The same run also failed on V1-0797 (internal/criterionexperiment goRequest) and V1-0765 (internal/tasks/store PSRTestResponseFailure, plus pools_test.go psrPools and program_*_host_test.go multiCommitted). Root cause of reaching main: V1-0359/V1-0400 (hosted CI does not run cross-vet). Expected: make cross-vet exits 0 on main. Actual: vet fails for GOOS=windows. Fix on branch claude/rc2-gate-fixes tags the three dispatch files `//go:build darwin || linux`.

completion.reason: Windows go vet of internal/tasks/dispatch fixed in 'Fix the rc.2 candidate's full-gate test defects'; cross-vet passes and internal/tasks/dispatch passes on darwin and linux. Hosted Release gates run 37466658604 on b7b21205 (published as v1.0.0-rc.2) passed full-gate on macos-15 and ubuntu-24.04 (make gate incl. cross-vet and go-test), and the local make gate passed on darwin/arm64 with the default symlinked TMPDIR; the SRR-V1 readiness record (sha256 above, corvint-release-evidence/1.0.0-rc.2-b7b21205) was built and verified.
